definitions.portfolio: Dated equity investments; undated companies are retrieved separately. Debt and grants are excluded.
definitions.amounts: USD whole-round amounts, not the investor's cheque, fund size, assets under management or investment returns.
definitions.follow_on: Another investor's later financing and this investor's repeat backing are distinct. Only entries with a full 24-month observation window enter the cohort.
definitions.sectors: Historical company tags can overlap; their counts are not additive and do not establish a current investment mandate.
definitions.directory: A directory's stored shortlist is a selected subset of its measured investor universe, not every investor in the database.
